description: Vision-only speed model: gradient-boosted regression trees predicting log km/h (v50 = median, v85 = 85th-percentile speed) from street-image features, Thailand only. Prediction = baseline + sum of leaf values; a row goes left when feature <= threshold, and a blank feature goes left when missing_left = 1. reference_row: median of each feature over the training rows (null = never measured), the reference for the factor attribution.

appearance.label: Overall look of the road (image embedding)

training.target: log of measured TomTom speed (km/h); v85 falls back to v50
training.rows: Thai segments with at least one street image
training.validation: 50 km spatial blocks, modal-block street assignment, 5 folds (as sseh_harm)
